KORN 100.title: Basic Korean I
KORN 100.description: An introduction to the grammar and syntax of modern spoken and written Korean.

KORN 101.title: Basic Korean II
KORN 101.description: Continuation of KORN 100. Recommended pre-requisite: KORN 100.

KORN 102.title: Basic Korean
KORN 102.description: An introduction to the grammar and syntax of modern spoken and written Korean. As of 2011W,

KORN 104.title: Basic Korean Grammar
KORN 104.description: Emphasis on grammar, writing, and reading. For heritage learners and students with prior background in spoken Korean.

KORN 161.title: Enriched Summer Intensive Beginning
KORN 161.description: An integrated language course developing communicative competence in speaking, listening to, reading, and writing modern Korean.

KORN 200.title: Intermediate Korean
KORN 200.description: Reading and writing of modern colloquial Korean at an intermediate level. As of 2011W, Recommended pre-requisites: one of KORN 101, KORN 102.

KORN 201.title: Intermediate Korean I
KORN 201.description: Reading and writing of modern colloquial Korean at an intermediate level. Recommended pre-requisite: KORN 101.

KORN 202.title: Intermediate Korean II
KORN 202.description: Continuation of KORN 201. Recommended pre-requisite: KORN 201.

KORN 300.title: Readings in Korean Topics
KORN 300.description: Readings in intermediate-level Korean on aspects of Korean culture, customs, and contemporary life, along with structured conversations based on those readings. As of 2011W, Recommended pre-requisites: one of KORN 200, KORN 202.

KORN 301.title: Readings in Korean Topics I
KORN 301.description: Readings in intermediate-level Korean on aspects of Korean culture, customs, and contemporary life, along with structured conversations based on those readings. As of 2011W, Recommended pre-requisite: KORN 202 or permission of instructor.

KORN 302.title: Readings in Korean Topics II
KORN 302.description: Continuation of KORN 301. As of 2011W, Recommended pre-requisite: KORN 301 or permission of instructor.

KORN 351.title: Introduction to Hancha: Sinographs and Sino-Korean Vocabulary I
KORN 351.description: Chinese characters in their Korean pronunciations and shapes. Students learn approximately 250 sinographs, related sinographic vocabulary, and do structured readings in mixed scripts on aspects of Korean culture and contemporary life.
KORN 351.prerequisiteText: One of KORN_V 200, KORN_V 202. Or placement approval

KORN 352.title: Introduction to Hancha: Sinographs and Sino-Korean Vocabulary II
KORN 352.description: Continuation of KORN_V 351. Students learn an additional 250 sinographs and related sinographic vocabulary.

KORN 410.title: Modern Korean Short Fiction
KORN 410.description: Reading and translating twentieth-century Korean short fiction. Recommended pre-requisites: either (a) KORN 300 or (b) all of KORN 301, KORN 302.

KORN 411.title: Advanced Readings in Korean Non-Fiction
KORN 411.description: Guided readings on contemporary affairs from the Korean press and/or selected readings in Korean academic prose. Recommended pre-requisite: KORN 300.

KORN 412.title: Korean-to-English Translation
KORN 412.description: Translation into English of Korean writing in various literary genres, including short story, poetry, personal essay, and academic essay. Supplementary readings in translation studies and translation theory.

KORN 415.title: Korean Conversation and Composition
KORN 415.description: Structured conversation practice and weekly composition assignments based on viewing one designated Korean television program per week. Recommended pre-requisite: KORN 300.

KORN 420.title: Readings in Middle and Early Modern Korean
KORN 420.description: History and structure of the Korean language through targeted close readings in different editions of an illustrated text from the 15th and 18th centuries.

KORN 420.prerequisiteText: Non-heritage speakers should have completed KORN 410 or be taking it concurrently. Heritage and native speakers of Korean welcome

KORN 440.title: Supervised Study in the Korean Language
KORN 440.description: Seminar in Korean-to-English literary translation. Primarily for, but not limited to, students in Asian Studies and Linguistics. Recommended pre-requisite: KORN 410 or placement exam.
